get.description:
https://api.apptotal.zscaler.com/v1/apps/app

Constraints:
  • For query parameters, ensure that the provided characters adhere to the specifications outlined in RFC 7230 and RFC 3986.
  • Special characters and encoding must follow the standards defined in RFC 3986.
Searches the 3rd-Party App Governance App Catalog by either app ID or URL (i.e., a valid consent or marketplace link). You must use one of the required parameters—app_id or url—for your search. If you use both an app ID and a URL for your search, an error is returned.
  • If the app is found in the catalog, a 200 response is received and the app's information is returned.
  • If the app is not initially found in the catalog, a 202 response is received and the app is submitted for analysis in the 3rd-Party App Governance Sandbox.

    • Note: After analysis is complete, a subsequent GET request is required to fetch the app's information. As a best practice, allow 24 hours for analysis and then resubmit the required GET request.
  • If the app is not found in the catalog, a 404 response is received.
  • If the URL is not valid, a 400 response is received.

    • Note: If you cannot find the app via the API, you can troubleshoot by manually searching for the app in the 3rd-Party App Governance Admin Portal. If you cannot find the app through manual search, contact Zscaler Support.
To learn more, see the Responses in the right-side panel.

get.description:
https://api.apptotal.zscaler.com/v1/app_views/{appViewId}/accounts

Retrieves the associated user accounts for a view ID.
This endpoint accepts a view ID and returns a map. Each key in the map is an app ID.
  • For app instances authorized by individual users, the value is an array of strings containing those users' email addresses.
  • For app instances that are authorized for the entire tenant, the value is `null`.
  • If an app instance has no users, the value is an empty array.

200.description: Success. Returns a map where keys are app IDs and values are a list of associated user emails. The value is `null` if the app is authorized for the entire tenant.

X-Rate-Limit-Remaining.description: The requests remaining until the quota limit is reached

400.description: Invalid Request Body. The list of app instance IDs in the request body cannot be empty.

Retry-After.description: The seconds remaining until the rate limit resets
